title: Remove the full-length entry card once nothing uses it
context: After Today and the day modal switch to compact cards, EntryCard (lib/features/entry_cards/entry_card.dart) has no callers, and neither do NotePreview with notePreviewOf (cards/note_preview.dart), which only EntryCard's preview path used, or DayDetailEntryTile. The read-back had put their removal out of scope because removing them deletes tests.
options: Leave the dead card and its tests for a separate change
Remove the card and what only it used in this change
outcome: Remove, on the owner's word: "If these have been completely removed from usage (which was the goal for consistency), then you have the permission to clean up this too." Tests that pin only the removed card's own chrome are deleted with it. Tests that pin a behaviour that survives elsewhere, such as note photo rendering or voice and video dispatch, are moved to the widget that now owns that behaviour, never dropped.
